hero.title: Building the infrastructure
hero.subtitle: VeloraCloud is a game hosting and cloud infrastructure company focused on giving communities fast, reliable, and affordable servers.

story.title: Our Story
paragraphs: VeloraCloud started with a simple goal: make high-performance game and cloud hosting accessible without the confusing pricing and inconsistent support that so many providers are known for.

Since launching on May 29, 2026, we've focused on building a platform around three things - speed, transparency, and genuinely helpful support - so that whether you're running a Minecraft server for friends or a growing Discord community, the infrastructure just works.
